source.name: measured vapour pressures and the critical point
source.fit: 12 measured values (0 from the ThermoML Archive, 12 from open-access articles), 298.26-403.30 K, max deviation 20 %. No measured critical constants: the record covers the measured temperatures only. All the measured sets fitted together, each article with the same weight (no set preferred for a smaller stated uncertainty), pooled because they agree: each set lies within its mean stated uncertainty of the curve on average; mean deviation of the fit from each set: Baird 2019 +1.78 %. The largest deviations are at values whose stated uncertainty exceeds 10 % (4 values, 18-27 %); among the values stated within 10 %, the largest deviation is 14 %.
